common.stopNoConfirm: Stop requested but no confirmation within 20s — the event stream may be broken. The backend turn may still be running; restart the app if the UI stays stale.

common.staleBusy: The previous turn is still running and holds this session (single input slot). Press Stop on the right to end it, then resend.
common.staleBusyStopped: The previous turn was stopped and the session is free — please resend.

backendError.title: Backend failed to start
backendError.desc: The Starriver backend could not start, so chat, models and projects are unavailable in this window. This is not a UI problem.
backendError.binaryMissing: The starriverd daemon binary was not found.
backendError.spawnFailed: The starriverd daemon exited during startup.
backendError.tokenMismatch: Authentication with the daemon failed (token mismatch).
backendError.versionMismatch: Client and daemon protocol versions do not match.
backendError.hintBinaryMissing: Build the daemon (cargo build -p starriverd) or reinstall the app, then retry.
backendError.hintSpawnFailed: Check the error detail below — port conflicts are listed there. Free the port or fix the config, then retry.
backendError.hintTokenMismatch: Delete ~/.starriver/daemon.json and stop any running starriverd, then retry.
backendError.hintVersionMismatch: Upgrade starriverd and the app to matching versions.
